title: Crispy Thai Chicken Bao
description: Delicious crispy Thai chicken served in soft bao buns. A perfect fusion of flavors.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil and swirl to coat the pan.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the Thai red curry paste to the skillet and stir to combine with the chicken.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the curry paste is fragrant.
Add the crispy wonton wrappers to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, until crispy.
Transfer the chicken mixture to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Cut the bao buns in half and toast until lightly browned.
Assemble the bao by spooning the chicken mixture into the bao buns and topping with cucumber, carrots, and green onions.
Drizzle with soy sauce and sprinkle with brown sugar to taste.
